protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: at tag 3000.10.2, KillAction authenticates the caller as a guest but routes authorization only through acl.IsAllowedKill; unlike dashboard methods it never calls checkDashboardAccess. aclCheck returns cfg.DefaultPermissions.Kill when no ACL matches. DefaultConfig sets Kill=true, while sanitizeAuthRequireGuestsToLogin clears View, Exec, and Logs but not Kill, so an unauthenticated guest can terminate a live action despite authRequireGuestsToLogin=true.
